## Problem routing

Map a symptom or task to where to start. Add a row every time a problem gets solved.

| Symptom / task                                                | Component      | Start at                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |
| ------------------------------------------------------------- | -------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Category image save fails / large upload error                | `src/services` | `src/services/categoryPhotos.ts` → `saveCategoryWithPhotos()`; HTML 413 = proxy body limit (nginx was 1 MiB until 2026-11-11)                                                                                                                        |
| Blog SEO score / Auto fix / clickable field robots            | `src/utils`    | `src/utils/blogSeo.ts` → `scoreBlogSeo()`, `parseAutoFix()`; UI `BlogSeoPanel.tsx`; robots `AIFieldAnimation` `assist`/`action` → `AIAssist`                                                                                                         |
| GSTIN autofill / validation in invoice form                   | `src/utils`    | `src/utils/gstin.ts` → `findGstDetails()`, `describeGstin()`; portal `src/services/gstinPortal.ts` → `lookupGstinOnPortal()` (backend `/crm/admin/gstin/:gstin`, Masters India); UI `invoiceDialog.tsx` → `handleGstinChange()`, `runPortalLookup()` |
| API error fields (code/stage/photoIndex), timeouts, multipart | `src/services` | `src/services/api.ts` → `ApiService.request()`                                                                                                                                                                                                       |
